perQuery.note: Elicit retrieves both must-have low-risk TAVR landmarks in the top two, while Manan finds the 6-year Evolut paper but misses the PARTNER 3 primary trial.
Both systems rank the exact DAPA-HF NEJM paper first, but Manan provides a broader, more clinically useful set of related RCTs and meta-analyses.
Both retrieve CLARITY-AD first, but Elicit better surfaces the major phase 2 and 36-month extension evidence, while Manan mixes in less central case-series and abstract-level items.
Elicit is more tightly focused on SGLT2 cardiovascular mortality meta-analyses in T2DM, while Manan includes strong evidence but also several heart-failure, kidney, and non-SGLT2-adjacent items.
Manan includes the 2016, 2020, and 2024 ESC AF guidelines in the top three, whereas Elicit omits the newest 2024 guideline and ranks older or translated versions higher.
Manan ranks high-quality meta-analyses first, while Elicit leads with a secondary summary source and includes a low-trust zero-citation journal item.

overall.summary: Manan wins three queries and Elicit wins three, but Manan has stronger consistency across metadata completeness, guideline recency, and clinically useful evidence lists. Elicit is best when citation-heavy landmark retrieval matters, especially for exact landmark recall in TAVR and lecanemab.
